comment: Read from src/Bernoulli at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Bernoulli. The trigger threshold is 2V rising and 0.1V falling, from Constants.hpp:147 and 148. The gate outputs are 10V, from the boolToGate macro at Utils.hpp:28. The normalling walks down from the last connected trigger jack (Bernoulli.cpp:171), so a gap in the middle of the column is filled from above rather than skipped. Every jack is read with getVoltage and written without setChannels, so the module is monophonic throughout even though its outputs could carry more.
